messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On what date was the EC declaration of conformity reproduced in the MA STAR two post lift manual issued?

response.text: In quale data è stata emessa la dichiarazione di conformità CE riprodotta nel manuale del ponte sollevatore a due colonne MA STAR?
